- ⛔ **The `Prior rulings read:` line was run in the WRONG REPO.** `check-prior-rulings.mjs` has no `--repo` flag by design and always reads **its own checkout**; this seat ran it in objectstack and pasted the answer onto an objectui card. objectui's `docs/adr/` holds **0001, 0034, 0036, 0053–0059** — ADR-0021 / 0029 / 0061 **do not exist here** (seat-verified, with objectstack as the control in the same command). ⇒ every such line this seat published on an objectui card is being corrected in place; six cards done.
